fact: 1938年9月，张伯伦三次飞赴贝希特斯加登、戈德斯堡与慕尼黑，9月29—30日在慕尼黑与希特勒、达拉第、墨索里尼签署协定，以苏台德换德国不再向欧洲提出领土要求；张伯伦回国后宣称'我们时代的和平'。

sources.title: Chamberlain and Hitler 1938（英国国家档案馆）
sources.quote: Chamberlain's flight to Berchtesgaden was followed by another to Godesberg a week later and then another to Munich on 29 September. At Munich, Chamberlain got an international agreement that Hitler should have the Sudetenland in exchange for Germany making no further demands for land in Europe. Chamberlain said it was 'Peace for our time'.
